change_rationale.reason: Use the implementation's existing 0.05 compatibility floor only for clients assigned p_malicious < 0.3, while leaving high-malicious-posterior weights and every paper training parameter unchanged. Because this is label-free, a truly malicious client misclassified by the GMM can receive the floor. This is the smallest existing switch that directly addresses the single observed concentration event.

seed_policy: Use a new independent calibration seed because the compatibility change was chosen after inspecting seed 31415. Formal seeds remain 2026-2030 and are untouched.
decision_rule: Promote unchanged to seeds 2026-2030 only if the seed-27182 final error is inside 15.7 +/- 0.4 percentage points and the run has no GMM fallback, non-finite, or weight-collapse diagnostics.
